summary_en: 760,000 shares (2.29% of shares outstanding) to be acquired on 3 August 2026 at ¥3,090/share via ToSTNeT-3 single block at 08:45 JST. Total outlay capped at ¥2,348.4M. Execution to settle same day. No partial fills; full block or no execution.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Treasury Stock Off-Market Purchase Transaction (ToSTNeT-3) Purchase
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, Nichiha's board authorized a single block acquisition of up to 760,000 ordinary shares (2.29% of the 33.23M shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥2,348.4M. The acquisition will be executed as a single off-market block purchase via ToSTNeT-3 at the Tokyo Stock Exchange on 3 August 2026 at 08:45 JST, at the closing price of ¥3,090 per share from 31 July. The buy order is good for that trading session only and does not carry over. Results will be announced immediately after trading closes. The company stated the purpose as enhancing shareholder returns and capital efficiency, and supporting agile capital policy in response to changing business conditions. Settlement occurs same day; the entire block either executes or does not — partial fills are excluded.
